title: Login page returns 500 error on submit
description: Users report that submitting valid credentials on the login page intermittently returns a 500 Internal Server Error. The issue seems to spike during peak hours.

comments.author: Acme Corp
comments.message: This is blocking our whole team from logging in.

comments.author: Priya Sharma
comments.message: Investigating the auth service logs now.

title: Dashboard charts not loading on Safari
description: The analytics charts render correctly on Chrome and Firefox but appear blank on Safari 17. No console errors are visible.

comments.author: Liam Chen
comments.message: Reproduced on Safari 17. Looks like a flexbox rendering bug.

title: Export to CSV produces empty file
description: When exporting the report to CSV with more than 10,000 rows, the downloaded file is empty. Smaller exports work fine.

title: Add dark mode support
description: Customers have requested a dark theme across the application for better accessibility and reduced eye strain.

comments.author: Maya Patel
comments.message: Design tokens are ready, implementing the theme switcher.

title: Password reset email never arrives
description: Several users report that the password reset email is not delivered. SPF and DKIM records appear correct.

comments.author: Priya Sharma
comments.message: Root cause was a misconfigured email provider rate limit. Fixed.

title: Mobile layout overlaps on small screens
description: On devices narrower than 360px, the navigation bar overlaps the page title. Needs responsive adjustment.

title: API rate limit too aggressive for enterprise plan
description: Enterprise customers are hitting rate limits during batch operations. Requesting a higher threshold for this tier.

comments.author: Stark Industries
comments.message: This is impacting our nightly data sync.

title: Typo in onboarding welcome email
description: The onboarding welcome email says "Welcom" instead of "Welcome" in the subject line.

title: Two-factor authentication codes expiring too quickly
description: TOTP codes are being rejected even when entered immediately. Suspect a server clock drift issue.

title: Search returns stale results after update
description: After updating a record, the search index does not reflect the change for several minutes.

comments.author: Liam Chen
comments.message: Reduced index refresh interval to 5 seconds.
